انتخبتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَخَبْتُنَّ (intaḵabtunna) /in.ta.xab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# اُنْتُخِبْتُنَّ (untuḵibtunna) /un.tu.xib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
